'''TC-93''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] belonging to [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Carina]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She formed an attachment to him and refused to perform [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] on him. While on an assignment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], TC-93 developed [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] and ran off to the [[Free Droid Enclave]] in the [[Network Security District]] with secret SIS intel. Carina later sent a fellow [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to retrieve the intel from TC-93, who provided it while refusing to return to his former master, whose obsession he described as "creepy".<ref name="TOR" />
